exercise.name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
steps: Hold a fixed bar at waist height, body straight and leaning forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your head under the bar.
Push back up by straightening your arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Hands on a fixed bar at waist height, body straight and leaning forward from the balls of the feet. The elbows bend ~110 deg to lower the head under the bar, then straighten. Triceps are the target.

setup.target: Fixed bar at waist height (~0.95 m), overhand, hands shoulder width.
Straight from heels to head, leaning forward 45 deg.

movement.path: Head lowers under the bar (library step 2).
Pivots on the feet as the head goes down.

muscles.emg: Overhead-arm elbow extension stretches the long head (S1); overhead extension 76% and lying extension 62% of the triangle push-up (S2).
muscles.surface: Back of the upper arm, shoulder to elbow.

mistakes.why_it_matters: Takes load off the arms; library step 1 says body straight.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250. doi:10.1080/17461391.2022.2100279
sources.what_it_gave: Elbow extension 90-0 deg with the arm overhead stretches the long head and grew the triceps 1.4-1.5x more than with the arm at the side.

sources.citation: Boehler B, Porcari JP, Kline D, Hendrix CR, Foster C, Anders M. 2011. ACE-sponsored research: best triceps exercises. ACE Certified News, August 2011.
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps EMG vs the triangle push-up (100%): kickback 87%, dips 87%, overhead extension 76%, lying barbell extension 62%.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: Feet on the floor, body straight
